description: Reference table of the world's top 50 container ports by 2024 TEU throughput, for use as the origin/destination port lookup in data_manager. Ranking and TEU figures from the World Shipping Council / industry 2024 statistics (see chat for sources). Coordinates and official port names for 'source': 'WPI' entries were pulled live from the NGA World Port Index public ArcGIS FeatureServer (https://services-eu1.arcgis.com/BuS9rtTsYEV5C0xh/arcgis/rest/services/World_Port_Index/FeatureServer/0) in September 2026 -- these are authoritative. A few WPI records use older/alternate romanizations or older terminal names than common usage; 'wpi_name' preserves the exact official WPI PORT_NAME field where it differs from the common 'name' used elsewhere in this project, and 'wpi_match_note' explains any judgment call. 'code' is a simple internal identifier generated for this project, not an official UN/LOCODE.

schema.code: string - internal facility code for this project
schema.name: string - common port name used elsewhere in this project
schema.teu_2024_thousands: int - approximate 2024 container throughput in thousands of TEU
schema.source: enum - WPI (verified against NGA World Port Index) | approximate (no WPI match found; general-knowledge estimate, verify independently)
schema.wpi_name: string, optional - exact official PORT_NAME as recorded in the WPI, when it differs from 'name'
schema.wpi_match_note: string, optional - explanation when the WPI match required a judgment call (nearest terminal, ambiguous multi-country result, older name, etc.)

ports.name: Shenzhen
ports.wpi_match_note: Shenzhen's main container gateway (Yantian) is the WPI-listed facility; Shenzhen itself is not a separate WPI PORT_NAME entry.

ports.name: Busan
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI uses the older McCune-Reischauer romanization 'Pusan'.

ports.name: Jebel Ali (Dubai)
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI lists it under the Arabic-transliterated name 'Mina Jabal Ali'.

ports.name: Tanger-Med
ports.wpi_match_note: This WPI edition only lists 'TANGER' (the older city port, 35.7833N -5.8167W), not a separate 'Tanger-Med' record for the deepwater container terminal ~40km northeast at approx. 35.88N -5.50W where 2024 TEU volume is actually handled. Coordinates here use the WPI TANGER record; treat as approximate for the actual Tanger-Med terminal location and verify separately if precision matters.

ports.name: Taicang/Suzhou
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI PORT_NAME match found for Taicang/Suzhou under names tried; kept as general-knowledge estimate.

ports.name: Kaohsiung
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI spells it with a hyphen.

ports.name: Beibu Gulf
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI PORT_NAME match found; Beibu Gulf Port is a multi-harbor administrative grouping (Qinzhou/Fangchenggang/Beihai), not a single WPI record.

ports.name: Tanjung Priok (Jakarta)
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI lists the port under 'Jakarta' rather than 'Tanjung Priok'.

ports.name: Hamburg
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI search for 'HAMBURG' also returns a 'Hamburg Harbor, Papua New Guinea' record; this entry is confirmed as Hamburg, Germany (COUNTRY=DE).

ports.name: Haiphong
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI spells it as two words.

ports.name: Cai Mep
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI record named 'Cai Mep'; used the WPI 'Phu My' record, the nearest listed facility in the same Cai Mep-Thi Vai deepwater port cluster (Vung Tau area), as a proxy. Treat coordinates as approximate for the specific Cai Mep terminals.

ports.name: Jawaharlal Nehru (Nhava Sheva)
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI spells it 'Nhava Shiva', not the more common 'Nhava Sheva'.

ports.name: Rizhao
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI PORT_NAME match found under names tried.

ports.name: Lianyungang
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI PORT_NAME match found under names tried.

ports.name: Savannah
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI search for 'SAVANNAH' also returns 'Savannah La Mar, Jamaica'; this entry is confirmed as Savannah, Georgia, USA (COUNTRY=US).

ports.name: Santos
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI search for 'SANTOS' also returns 'General Santos, Philippines'; this entry is confirmed as Santos, Brazil (COUNTRY=BR).

ports.name: Abu Dhabi (Khalifa Port)
ports.wpi_match_note: WPI lists the Arabic-transliterated 'Abu Zaby'; Khalifa Port itself is not a separate WPI record, so these are the general Abu Dhabi port-area coordinates, not the specific Khalifa Port terminal.

ports.name: Colon
ports.wpi_match_note: The Caribbean-side container port at Colon is listed in WPI as 'Puerto Cristobal'.

ports.name: Piraeus
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI PORT_NAME match found under 'PIRAEUS', 'PIR', or 'ATHIN' searches in this WPI edition; kept as general-knowledge estimate.

ports.name: Bremen/Bremerhaven
ports.wpi_match_note: Container operations are concentrated at Bremerhaven, the WPI-listed facility, rather than Bremen proper.

ports.name: Dongguan
ports.wpi_match_note: No WPI PORT_NAME match found under names tried; kept as general-knowledge estimate.
